intelligence.essence: Smart Mail and Smart Messenger are your private communication system on NayaNET — one place to send, receive, and organize your messages, and to talk instantly with anyone on the network. Mail and Messenger are one interface: your inbox, your instant messenger, and your poster, all together.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine having a magic mailbox that sorts all your letters for you, tells you which ones matter most, and keeps them safe — and a telephone that lets you talk to any of your friends instantly. That's Smart Mail and Smart Messenger: your letters and your talking, all in one place.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine a post office that delivers your letters, keeps them organized, and never, ever opens them to read what's inside — and a telephone on the same desk so you can call anyone you love in an instant. That's your Smart Mail: private, organized, and yours.
